en: A sepia-toned vintage studio portrait of a woman standing next to an ornate wooden pedestal. She is dressed in late 19th or early 20th-century attire, with a high-necked, buttoned bodice and a long skirt, holding a book in her hand. Ornamental details are visible in the backdrop and the pedestal. Cyrillic text and a coat of arms are present at the bottom of the image.
